item.title: Top Republic Days at Hindi Box Office: Sunny Deol's Border 2 takes 2nd spot, Pathaan leads by margin
item.description: Border 2, directed by Anurag Singh, registered a smashing day on Republic Day, collecting Rs. 53 crore net at the Hindi box office. The movie recorded the second biggest Republic Day of all time, leaving Hrithik Roshan's Fighter behind by a huge margin. Starring Sunny Deol, Varun Dhawan, Diljit Dosanjh, and Ahan Shetty, Border 2 trailed only behind Shah Rukh Khan starrer Pathaan which collected Rs. 67.80 crore net on the same day in 2023.
